subject: general
question: Which of the following combinations of “animal” and “area they found” is INCORRECT ?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Orangutan - Caribbean islands.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Orangutans** are **not **found in the Caribbean islands, but rather in the rainforests of **Borneo and Sumatra **in Southeast Asia.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d114c8cfa2dcf3a751d6bf4c4752fbf6108ddcbe2356c86bc4ad48ab5b732eda.png] 

 
• **Kangaroos** are primarily found in** Australia**, but also in **Papua New Guinea** and nearby islands.
 
• **Ostriches **are found in **savanna** and **desert regions of Africa.**
 
• **Lemurs** are only found in **Madagascar**, an island off the coast of Southeast Africa.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Orangutans** are known for their long, powerful arms and reddish-brown hair.
 
• **Kangaroos **are **marsupials,** meaning they carry their young in a pouch, and they are known for their powerful hind legs and tails.
 
• **Ostriches **are the** largest living bird species** and are known for their long necks and powerful legs.
 
• **Lemurs **are primates that are only found in **Madagascar,** and they are known for their large eyes and long, bushy tails.
